# Soap Film (`soapFilm`)

A draining soap film in soft light: real interference colour, folded by slow eddies.

- Type: scene (draws its own image; put it first)
- Reacts to: nothing outside itself (pure motion)
- Cost: medium (~4.9 ms/frame at 5K on a Pro GPU)
- Built-in styles: Soap Film, Oil Slick
